system.description: Lavishly hand-written and containing many intricate diagrams and illustrations, this scroll is a vastly simplified magical formula. It is bound with a wax seal, featuring the rune of its associated wind of magic and, by extension, college. Encumbrance: Trivial Reading this scroll is an Education (Int) check with a difficulty equal to the rank of the spell inscribed within, plus any difficulty modifiers inherent to the spell. Casting a spell from outside your college is even more difficult for non-wizards. Scrolls are described in more detail in Winds of Magic, pages 35-36.
